rows.text: On 16 November 1990 the Prime Minister, Shri Chandra Shekhar, moves in the Lok Sabha that the House expresses its confidence in the Council of Ministers, after the Speaker rules that the motion is in order.

locator.item: 'THE PRIME MINISTER (SHRI CHANDRA SHEKHAR): I beg to move'

rows.text: The confidence motion moved by Shri Chandra Shekhar is carried on a division at 19.13 hrs: subject to correction, Ayes 269, Noes 204; the motion is adopted and the House is adjourned sine die.

locator.item: 'The Lok Sabha divided' (Division No. 1, 19.13 hrs); 'Ayes: 269 / Noes: 204 / The motion was adopted'
